question: What is Diginex

beat.line: It is built to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
beat.headline: BANKS & FUNDS
beat.action: The previous chip slides down as the conveyor's far end folds up into cutout buildings that line up and hold.

sources: Following acquisitions of Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, and the transformative addition of Resulticks, Diginex is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform spanning carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency, human rights due diligence, and now AI-driven customer data capabilities — designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
This is particularly relevant for regulated entities (banks, asset managers) facing mounting ESG disclosure requirements and climate risk scrutiny.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: cutout buildings; the conveyor.
Opens on the conveyor, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides down as the conveyor's far end folds up into cutout buildings that line up and hold.
Ends holding on the row of buildings.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "BANKS & FUNDS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "BANKS & FUNDS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "It is built to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with 2D motion design, photographed as a flat lay under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, which features a pale cyan, single-block color paper ground. In the upper third of the frame, a cream-colored paper chip with rough torn edges displays the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "END-TO-END". In the lower two-thirds, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a conveyor belt spans the width of the frame, featuring rough white torn-paper edges. A consistent light source from the upper left casts small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer. At 00:00.000, as the action begins, the "END-TO-END" chip slides rapidly downward and off-screen with a slight overshoot. Simultaneously, a new cream-colored paper chip slides in from the top, landing stably in the upper third of the frame with the clean, legible black text "BANKS & FUNDS". In the lower section, the conveyor belt cutout begins to transform; the far end of the belt folds upward and creases like real paper, unfolding into a row of black-and-white halftone photographic cutout buildings. These buildings, all unmarked and devoid of any symbols or text, line up horizontally across the lower half of the frame. Every element is matte printed paper with a flat finish and no glow. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. The animation concludes with a hold on the stable composition of the "BANKS & FUNDS" headline and the row of cutout buildings. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says <d>[English] It is built to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.</d> starting from the first frame.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, tactile foley sounds accompany the motion, including the sharp slap of paper hitting paper and the sticky, subtle peel and press of adhesive tape. These sounds are synchronized with the sliding of the chips and the folding of the paper buildings.
